messages:
haley: quick sync — we need to lock down the audit evidence sampling policy for Q4 SOC2 prep. customers keep asking for narrower scopes and different retention carve-outs. putting it here so we can decide tradeoffs by next Wed.
pranav: +1. do we have a proposed minimum evidence set? e.g., login events, admin actions, model changes, deploys, audit logs? can we compress into a checklist?
ivy: draft checklist inlined below — I kept items pragmatic for infra and privacy:
```
- Authentication events (successful/failed)
- Admin console actions (role changes, key rotations)
- KMS/HSM usage logs (key create, rotate, destroy)
- Model rollout events (version, canary, rollback)
- API exposure map (routes that accept customer PII)
- Retention markers (when evidence becomes eligible for purge)
```
linus: looks good. main constraint: retention windows for evidence require ops storage budget. if we keep 1 year for everything it costs a lot. propose tiered retention: 90d default, 1y for enterprise, 7d for dev/test orgs.
marie: legal flagged customer-driven exceptions — some customers (gov/reg) require longer than 1y and exportable bundles for audits. we need a launch criteria that includes an "export package" feature.
haley: noted. proposal: mandatory features before GA: evidence checklist implemented for hosted + dedicated, export package generation for requests, KMS/HSM event capture validated, and retention policy config per org. everything else can be beta.
pranav: can we codify export package minimal fields? think: signed manifest, compressed evidence (logs + snapshot), schema v1 metadata. sample manifest sketch:
```
{
  "org_id": "<org>",
  "period_start": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "period_end": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "evidence_types": ["auth","kms","deploy"],
  "hash": "sha256:...",
  "signed_by": "redwood-auditor@redwood.com"
}
```
ivy: +1. also need an automated sampling config to avoid generating huge exports — e.g., all admin actions but 10% sample of normal auth events unless a flagged incident.
linus: ops note: sampling implies index-able markers in the log store. we should add a migration to add `audit_sample_flag` to the events index. estimated 3d infra work.
marie: compliance note: sampling has to be defensible — we need documented rationale and a math model (confidence intervals) to present to auditors.
haley: action items: (1) pr from ivy with checklist and export manifest spec (owner: ivy) due Tue EOD, (2) linus to scope infra index change + cost estimate (owner: linus) due Tue EOD, (3) pranav to draft launch-criteria PR referencing GA vs beta feature list (owner: pranav) due Thurs, (4) marie to draft auditor-facing rationale for sampling (owner: marie) due Fri. @eng-bot can we add these to the security roadmap board?
eng-bot: task created: SEC-AUD-2192 (evidence-sampling + export-package) — owners: ivy, linus, pranav, marie — due 1767891200
pranav: quick Q — do we include private/on-prem in scope for exports day-1? that has network/airgap complications.
haley: not day-1. plan: hosted + dedicated supported at GA; private/on-prem T1 for next quarter with a different exporter (local bundle generator) and docs.
ivy: will add a doc section for private deploy caveats (HSM keys never leave customer site, so manifest will reference local proofs instead of raw logs).
linus: one more thing — for KMS/HSM we need to capture key usage but avoid storing key material. will record operations + key IDs only.
marie: OK. this thread helped. moving to formal RFC next week; please review PRs when posted. :thumbsup:
